item.title: What is a cat delete?
item.description: Removing your catalytic converter may be tempting for the power gains, but that extra power could come at an extra cost.

item.title: China is pulling the plug on yoke steering wheels and hidden door handles
item.description: Beginning January 1, 2027, yoke-style steering wheels and flush door handles will be banned on new vehicles in China.

item.title: Ford Island Conquest returns for its 9th edition in Alabang
item.description: Ford Philippines opens 2026 with Ford Island Conquest at Alabang, showcasing hybrids, EVs, test drives, and promos.

item.title: 2026 Hyundai Stargazer X Review | Better got great!
item.description: The 2026 Hyundai Stargazer X got an update. More ground clearance, more features, and a more rugged look make the Stargazer X a worthwhile upgrade over the standard Stargazer. Even if it is an upgrade over the previous version, we want to ask, "how big is this upgrade?" Let's find out on this episode of Behind the Wheel.

item.title: Isuzu Philippines takes part in the 2026 Overland Kings campout
item.description: IPC celebrates the outdoor lifestyle at Overland Kings Campout, showcasing the D-MAX LS-E 4x4 as a capable companion.

item.title: ACMobility unveils ChargeFleet, a new solution for fleet charging
item.description: The new ChargeFleet platform helps businesses manage EV charging expenses with one shareable wallet.

item.title: Ford Everest leads 4x4 mid-size SUV segment, Mustang tops sports car segment in the Philippines for 2025
item.description: Two icons, two crowns: The Ford Everest dominates 4x4 SUVs while the Mustang remains king of sports cars in 2025.

item.title: Suzuki updates the Jimny 3-Door with Suzuki Safety Support
item.description: The Jimny 3-Door now has Suzuki Safety Support, bringing advanced driver assist tech to the iconic off-roader.

item.title: LTO releases guidelines on the use of temporary certificate of registration
item.description: The LTO released a circular detailing guidelines on the use and issuance of temporary CRs as it faces another shortage.

item.title: Mitsubishi Motors Philippines wins Service Advisor Champion title at Global Service Skills Contest in Japan
item.description: MMPC celebrates a victory after service advisor Raymond Rivera shines at the Global Service Skills Contest 2025.
